newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia late rubber SIR20 falls in slow trading.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia late rubber SIR20 falls in slow trading.

text.p: Indonesian tyre-grade SIR20 offer prices fell in slow late trading on Monday, with Singapore buying failing to boost sentiment, dealers said.
Dealers said January SIR20 offer prices fell 0.25 U.S. cents/lb to 55.00-55.50 cents fob Medan, 54.75-55.25 fob Surabaya, Padang and Palembang, 54.00-54.50 fob Pontianak and Jambi.
Singapore-based firms bought January SIR20 at 54.75 cents fob Palembang late on Friday, one Jakarta dealer said.
Demand for December/January SIR20 were soft due to year-end factors and there were only few enquiries for February, dealers said.
They said there were likely to be few deals done later today due to weak sentiment following falls in Tokyo rubber futures market.
Dealers said prompt delivery latex was on offer at 2,150 rupiah/kg against the previous 2,200 rupiah due to weak demand.
